title: A live site whose PHP is below Claude Cowork's minimum is named LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD with both versions, never unreachable
steps: Stand a stand-in engine that answers every call with HTTP 200 and {ok:false,error:'php_too_old',code:'php_too_old',php:'7.3.33',min:'7.4.0'} (claude-cowork 0.24.73 on PHP 7.3).
Run live-pull.mjs and live-write.mjs info against it; run a live-write apply whose door check passes and whose content call answers that refusal.
Ask the Joomla import's door (resolveDoor) and install proof against the same answer, and read the tracy-web sync and push views of the stored answers.
expect: live-pull and live-write answer code LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD with php 7.3.33 and min 7.4.0 after exactly one request (no other door, no retry).
A mid-Apply refusal ends LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD (not WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN) and written.json carries php and min; other stops keep their shape.
The import refuses php_too_old with php 7.3.33, minimumPhp 7.4.0 and check below_minimum; the views carry php {php:'7.3.33', min:'7.4.0'}.
evidence: Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.73 answers both doors with HTTP 200 and php_too_old on PHP below 7.4; Tracy reported it as LIVE_READ_FAILED / LIVE_UNREACHABLE or 'check Claude Cowork is installed'.
fence: The engine's php_too_old answer maps to LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD (fleet) and php_too_old (import) carrying only bare version strings.

tests: pull: an engine refusing the site's PHP is LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD with both versions
push: an engine refusing the site's PHP is LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD with both versions
PHP too old found mid-Apply: written.json carries the engine’s versions; other stops keep their shape
an engine that says its PHP is too old is php_too_old with its own versions, at install and at the door
a push stopped by a live PHP too old for Claude Cowork names both versions, in each phase
pure pieces: LIVE_PHP_TOO_OLD names only versions, from the answer, its read or a push sync
